batting.name: Arshad Khan

balls.text: lands between Moeen heading towards deep point, and the deep point fielder rushing forward. Another yorker length ball outside off, which is sliced high with an open face of the bat
yorker bang on off, Chawla gets a bottom edge while trying to swing at it. The ball rolls over to the keeper

good catch by Jadeja! Looked like he was stationed at point, but he surely ended at where an imaginary cover-point would have been. Stubbs went slashing at this full ball outside off, while playing with a flat bat. But it was a change-up from Pathirana, as he rolled his fingers through it, and the ball skied up towards the circle
a high-ish full toss on the stumps, and swatted back towards the bowler's right leg. They pinch a single
looks to drive at this full ball outside off, but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Pathirana touches 150kph

sliced to deep point! Gaikwad there juggles it twice, before clutching it between his stomach and legs. The ball was fired on a very full length, angling across to finish on off. Arshad opened the bat face to send it flaying flat to the man in the deep, but although it seemed to be timed well, it went right to the fielder
crashes this full ball outside off down to long-off's right, even as the sub fielder Rasheed tumbles to his right to keep it to two. That seemed headed for four
rammed back over the non-striker! Very full outside off, and finally Stubbs gets one away with a loft down the pitch
dropped by Dube at long-off! Ah, that looked like a sitter, with Dube almost seeming to take a bit too easy. Short ball outside off, as Arshad swatted it back with a flat bat

mistimes it to long-off! Gaikwad on the boundary takes a few steps forward while keeping his eyes on the ball, and gobbles it. It was quite a full ball around sixth stump, as David - who was deep in the crease - tried to loft but mis-hit. I think the length was a bit too full to facilitate that loft down the pitch
wide ball. Saw David get across for a second, and went on a good length and quite wide of off, as it angled away further. Left alone by David
gets across, and the bowler goes full and wide of off. Pushed to long-on off the inside half of the bat
drills this full and wide ball outside off to deep point
change of pace. Bowls short and a bit wide of off, while slowing it down. Stubbs can only swat it back to the bowler
another low full toss on off - and this is at 147kph - while being pushed back towards long-on
yorker length and wide of off, as David tries to poke but is beaten

gone! Hits middle stump! He saw Wadhera get across the stumps early, and Pathirana fired a yorker at 145kph. It was dipping on to the batter, and turned out to be too low and too quick for Wadhera's attempted flick. He was beaten, as the ball hit the base of the middle stump to end a very good knock
quite full on off this time, and is dragged to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
length ball a bit wide of off, as Stubbs keeps missing. He looked to hack but was beaten
four more for MI and Wadhera! Jadeja has an expensive day, as MI up the ante. Length ball outside off, and this Wadhera half-scooped-half-swept it over short fine
right between long-on and deep midwicket! Jadeja keeps bowling quick, but now goes short outside off. Wadhera anticipates it, and pulls convincingly
he stands with his front leg out of the way, as this good length ball turns away towards off. Swiped to deep midwicket
shortish on middle, and quicker at 103kph. Pulled to deep square
slog sweeps to short fine's right! Good length ball on the stumps, and he even fine leg running to his left
good length on off, and nudged towards long-on after a step out. That is very good running, as he raises his fifty
full just outside off, and pushed down to long-off to round off a good over for MI
short outside off, and punched to deep point
now the legspinner on a good length outside off. Pushed back to the bowler's right after it turned away
tries the reverse sweep, and just beats Dhoni! It just had a little tickle off his glove, as the ball was an offspinner outside off, which hinted to turn in
yorker length outside off, and dug out to the bowler's left. Theekshana dives to his left, but can't prevent a hurried run
the first six of the day! A confident loft over long-on. It was a carrom ball on a length on middle, as Wadhera came out and slammed that high
chipped on the bounce to extra cover! And then Stubbs dives back, as Deshpande throws at the striker's end, but wide of the stumps. Length ball slanted across off, and just pushed by Stubbs
shortish ball outside off, and slapped to deep point

Dhoni tumbles to his left, but can't stop the ball. It was a short ball outside off, which rose nicely. Wahdera pulled early - he was perhaps beaten by the lack of pace - as the ball hit near his shoulder before running behind
quite full on off, and pushed to long-on
too full and too quick at 144kph. That was bowled a bit wide of off, as Stubbs tried to stab but missed
swipes this full ball on his pads to deep square. Looked like it almost came off the inside half of the bat
full and quick on middle. Driven to long-off
another half an appeal for lbw, as this full ball landed just about on leg as he missed his flick. It was a carrom ball though
a boundary after a long time! Full toss outside off, as Wadhera went down to sweep and placed it to short fine's right. The man in the deep slid to his right but in vain
swipes at this full ball on the stumps, as the ball goes wide of long-on. Quick running there
skips out, and punches this good length ball on middle back to the bowler
looks to sweep this full ball outside off, but is hit on his pad. Half an appeal for leg before wicket turned down
flicks this good length ball outside leg wide of the fine leg fielder for two, even as the bowler slowed it down
good length on his pads, and clipped to deep backward square
short ball now. Bangs it in on middle, as the batter looks to pull but is beaten
very full and outside leg, as he tickles this behind to the man at a straightish fine leg
shortish ball on off at 141kph. Punched towards midwicket as the bat turns in his hands
full and a bit wide of off. Driven on the up to deep point
good length on off, and punched back after getting deep in the crease. He was almost squared up there by the turn away from him
a bit fuller and quicker at 104kph on the stumps. Driven to long-off
good length on the stumps, and pushed back for another dot
almost chops on! Dabs at this good length ball outside off, which turns in towards off. The ball goes past the stumps and Dhoni though
full outside leg, and tucked towards fine leg
makes room, and the bowler follows. He goes full and outside leg, as Wadhera is forced to push it back to the bowler
steps out, and nudges this length ball outside off to wide long-on
squares him up with some turn off a good length on middle. Takes his outside edge to point, as he looks to block
short and a bit wide of off. Punched to the man at extra cover

bowled him! Jadeja fires one in at 102kph, and Surya is beaten by the pace. Surya stands after giving himself room, and looks to slash hard at this shortish ball on middle and off. But he is beaten, and the ball zips through to smack the stumps and break a steady stand to bring CSK back
good length just outside off. Hacked to deep point
slog swept over short fine! Gets across off early, and goes behind the wicket as the ball is full and quick outside off
another reverse sweep as the ball is full again outside off, and this time he finds the short-third fielder
reverse sweeps this full ball outside off, which dribbles behind the keeper
full toss on middle, and just beats the cover fielder to his left. It was driven uppishly, and almost gave an impression that it would land right into the fielder's hands
yorker length ball on the stumps. Dug out by Surya, as the bowler bowls at 103kph
good length and quicker on middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
length ball on middle and off, and pushed back
whips this full and fast ball outside off to long-on, as Jadeja touches 100kph again
full on middle, and pushed to long-on
much fuller, and again quick on middle and off. Pushed to cover, as Surya is sent back
takes a step down, and whips this shortish ball on off towards fine leg
slashes this shortish ball outside off to point
good length on the stumps at 100kph. Punched to deep midwicket
full on middle, and slower. Defended towards cover
good length outside off, and turns in towards off. Poked towards cover for a quick single
good length on his pads. Clipped to fine leg
slammed to deep extra cover! Backed away early, and slapped this full ball on the stumps in big gap there
full and outside off, and keeps low as Surya misses his slog sweep. The ball beats Dhoni too after taking Surya's pad
tossed up, and it's a full toss outside off first ball. Surya swipes between the long-on and deep midwicket fielders to welcome Moeen
good length outside off, and clipped to the bowler's left
shortish on the leg stump, and clipped to deep midwicket
short again outside off, and hacked aerially to deep point
ah, that just trickled away to deep backward point! Short and just outside off, as Wadhera slapped it late while using the pace of the bowler
sweeps this length ball around off quite early, and towards short fine
good length on off, and tapped towards short third
starts with a good length ball outside leg. Surya lets it go, and it runs off Dhoni's glove to allow another run
slower ball, on a full length on off. Tucked to mid-on for a quick single to end the powerplay
perhaps an attempted yorker, as it landed low on his front foot, but outside leg, as he missed his flick
stylishly pulled to deep backward square! Sits deep in the crease, and pulls with his front leg in the air, almost while overbalancing. Short ball outside off, and he uses his wrists to pull

just over Moeen at short midwicket! The mid-on fielder then traces it back all the way, pulling it back with a slide. Good length ball angling into leg, as Surya chipped it with the movement. By the way, replays confirm it was a clean stop by Pathirana
the point fielder dives to his left and gets a hand, even as the ball dribbles away towards the rope. Full ball outside off, as Surya sliced that with the open face of the bat
good length on middle. He opens the bat face to poke to cover, as they take off
yorker length ball on off - and another slower ball - and driven to extra cover
steps out a bit, but dabs this shortish ball on middle and off back to the bowler
change of pace, and short in length. At just 118kph, as he pitches it on the shorter side of a length outside off. It angles away further, as Wadhera lets it go
much fuller, and just outside off. He taps to point from deep in the crease
pulled to deep square leg! Short delivery from Chahar, as it angles across to end outside off. Wadhera slaps it away while getting on top of the bounce
goes stabbing at this full ball on sixth stump, but is beaten. Withdraws his bat last moment
punched wide of mid-on, as this good length ball angles into leg. The deep-midwicket fielder slides to his left to cut that off
change of pace again, as he bowls on a length just outside off. Pushed off the inside half of the bat, as the ball trickles to the leg side
pushes at this full ball outside off to mid-on, as the bat turns in his hands
shortish ball in the channel outside off. He rides the bounce, and tucks to deep third
slower ball, and beaten. Bowls at only 125kph, and goes full outside off. Wadhera looks to push, but has little clue, with the ball passing his bat
good length on fifth stump. Tapped to point after getting across
low full toss, and flicked wide of mid-on to get off the mark

gone, lobbed up to point! The moment Dhoni comes up to the stumps, Rohit tries something different: he went to scoop this good length ball around middle and off, but the length was slightly shorter than what the shot ideally is suited for. Rohit seemed to have played early, and the ball popped up off the splice of the bat before taking his bottom thumb towards point, with Jadeja almost catching it in front of short third
quite slow from Chahar at only 126kph, as he bowls full and on off. Dabbed towards cover, as Rohit is sent back
good length ball angling into his pads. Flicked to deep square after getting across off

this is ballooned.... and mid-on settles under it! That went very highhhhh up. Theekshana had his eyes on it for a long time, and finally grabbed it with a reverse cup in front of his face. Kishan looked to flick this good length ball on middle, and seemed to have closed the face of the bat early. That meant he got a leading edge, and the ball skied up for a comfortable catch

high full toss flung outside off. Kishan swipes to mid-on on the bounce. Not called an above-waist no-ball. And MI review. But replays show it was dipping towards the batter, and was ending below the waist. Some time - and a review - taken away
taps this length ball outside off to point

gone, the stumps are clipped! Green looked to pull, but the length wasn't as short as he would have liked. Deshpande landed it on a good length on off, but it didn't really get up as per the length. Green was early into his shot, he missed, and the off stump was disturbed
opens the bat face to guide this good length ball angling across to end wide-ish of off. Single to deep third
shorter side of a length on off. Pushed to mid-on for a hurried single
good length on middle, as he tries to clip but gets an inside edge. The ball dribbles towards extra cover
starts with a full and wide ball outside off. Kishan goes flashing with a flat bat but is beaten
lofted over extra cover! He stands after making room, and presents the full face of the bat to this good length ball around middle and off. He has a long reach, and sends it over the fielder
fuller ball on off, and driven to deep point's left
and again beaten! Kishan pokes at this good length ball on fifth stump, but sees the ball pass his outside edge. Some cat-and-mouse stuff here
whipped to deep backward square! It was more of a pick-up shot, as Chahar swung it into the left-hander, while pitching on a length on middle. Flicked with the movement
beaten outside off! Kishan hangs his bat out at this length ball angling across, and finishing on sixth stump. The ball goes past the outside edge
good length ball angles in to end on leg. Clipped to deep midwicket, as he stands outside leg
He pulls it effortlessly along square with his front leg up, easy single taken and CSK win with 14 balls to spare
Length ball at 136kph is thrashed to long-on with limited timing for a single that causes a huge roar
Helped fine, it's in MI's dugout over the boundary. 66-metre six and Rohit grimaces. Shortish ball angled in, just over the waist and Dube swivelled and found power this time
Slower bouncer outside off beats the pull. Dube swivelled and his upper-body fell away as he completed the shot
Pulls a shortish ball around head-height just outside off to deep-backward square
Length on middle, flicked to deep square leg
Back of length outside off at 135kph, punched defensively to cover

Conway goes across and falls as he tries to paddle, ball hits him and deflects to the keeper's left, on its way to the boundary. Rohit and Madhwal have a chat and decide to review. The full ball pitched outside off and Conway's back leg was close to the off-side tramline and the front leg was stuck right in front of the stumps. Hawk-Eye shows three reds and Conway has to go
Shortish ball just outside off is pulled to deep square leg

Conway's not sure where the ball is but Dube sees it's in the crease, close to the leg-stump tramline, calls and takes off for the run. Length ball following the batter, beat the flick, hit the thigh pad and fell onto the ground. Bowler ran in and tried to push it with his boot but couldn't
Conway tries to reverse sweep without a follow-through, the yorker takes the underedge of the the bat and rolls towards short fine leg
Length outside off, punched with a horizontal bat to long-off
Conway missed out on the leg-stump full-toss. Got on one knee and tried to paddle it away but got hurried by the pace of the ball. Went off the gloves to short fine
Dube tries to pull the length ball outside off without any foot movement and the bat turns in the hand. Ball goes into the pitch, to the bowler's left where it isn't fully stopped
Length outside off, guided to short third
Punches the length ball outside off to long-off
Pulls a short ball just outside off into the ground, to deep square leg
Short outside off, cut to deep point. Pace: 144kph
Flicks a full ball to long-on
Flicked off the hips to midwicket
Blocks the length ball outside off to cover
Wide on a slot, Dube tries to mow the slower one over midwicket but misses
Pulls a short ball to midwicket
Too full, Dube slog sweeps a mile over deep midwicket. Rohit has his hands cupped and goes oooo as the ball sails over. The max height of the parabola was 36 metres, shows the graphic on the telecast
Sticks in the pitch and was slow in the air, so Dube, who was setting up for a big hit had to go back and push it back to the bowler
Full ball is worked back to the bowler
Short enough for Dube to muscle the pull over midwicket. It's slow on a back of length, pitches well outside off and comes into fourth stump, Dube whacks it flat for his first six
Shortish ball doesn't rise, it's on leg and is pulled to deep midwicket
Turns away to beat the outside edge. Flatter length ball lands around off and Dube tries to block it towards cover, misses

Cut straight to short third and the chants of Dhoni, Dhoni ensue. Soft dismissal as it was a shortish wide ball that was slow and sat up for the cut. Rayudu went for it but the angle from around the wicket led to the edge for it to balloon to Raghav
Down the track, mowed over wide long-on for an 81-metre six. Got to the pitch, it was straight, so in the line of his reach and swung across almost 360 degrees
Conway goes across and on one knee early and Stubbs hurls a full toss at 86kph, paddled to short fine
Full just outside off, Rayudu takes a step down, lunges away from the body to drive to deep cover point
Full ball is flicked to long-on
Sits up, Conway tries to muscle the pull but it hits the bottom which costs some timing. He grunts as he goes for the run, ball went along the turf to deep midwicket
Conway went across to sweep it into the ground, goes to the left of long leg. Batters' quick running allows a comfortable two
Bottom hand comes off but Conway is able to chip the full ball outside off over cover, long-off runs across to keep it to two
Length outside off, steered to deep point
Pulls the length ball outside off that sits up well, to deep square leg. Conway cleared his front leg early which meant his access was restricted and he had premeditated to hit it leg side
Length on leg, swept to deep backward square
Full outside off, driven to Chawla's left. He goes low and tries stopping it, it hits the left hand. He wrings his hand and Simon Doull, on air, jokes it might be a convenient sore finger.
Tossed up on middle, overpitched at 88kph, driven to cover
Leading edge off the flick but the lack of power takes it low. Ball fizzles along the ground to short third and they run a quick single. Was a length ball on middle
Full on off, defended to the bowler's right
Clipped uppishly, midwicket tumbles to the left but is not in reach. Ball goes to long-on. Chawla bowled a full ball outside off
Pulls the length ball outside off along the ground, to the right of deep midwicket. Pace: 86kph
Length outside off, punched to the bowler's left
Length outside off, ball comes back in. Rayudu takes a step across before punching the ball close to the body. Gets it to cover
Full ball around off at 81kph is flicked to deep midwicket
Full down leg at 83kph, would've been wide had Rayudu left it but he nudges it behind square
Fullish ball outside off, cut with the spin to the right of deep point for an easy single
Underedge off the cut hits the grass and goes to the left of the keeper. Was a length ball outside off

Inside edge beaten, given LBW. Rahane reviews with a couple of seconds remaining. Googly landed on a length around off and came in a bit. Rahane took a small stride and tried to block it towards mid-on, missed it and got hit on the knee-roll of the front leg. Hawk-Eye came up with two reds but the graphic didn't play to the end so there's a wait. It comes back after a minute. Hawk-Eye shows the impact is flush on off and it'd go on on to hit the top of middle
Rahane goes back to a fullish ball on middle and leg and clips it to midwicket
Conway's back leg goes up as he reaches out and blocks the length ball to cover
Full on off, clipped to long-on. Pace: 85kph
Overpitched and Rahane launches it over mid-on for 74-metre six. It was just outside off, Rahane step-hit it with ease and marked his guard right after hitting it
Length outside off, pushes to point. Tries to take off for a single before deciding against it
Googly around fifth stump, square driven with the spin to deep point
Tries to nudge a full ball just outside leg across the line. Misses, deflects off the pad to the leg side. Pace: 78kph
Full on off, clipped to long-on
Length on leg, clipped to short fine
Long hop outside off, Conway clears the front leg, launches it over cover. No one in the deep, easy four
Sider outside off, worked to deep square leg
Full outside off, Rahane lunges across and flicks it with a roll of the wrist to the right of long-on. Rahane played it softly to try and get two but the fielder did well to get to it quick
Full ball is worked to deep midwicket
Full ball at 81kph on leg is directed to long-on with a push
Chipped inside out over cover but long-off is able to go to the right and get to the ball. Ball was full outside off
Works a full ball outside off to long-on
Thrashed to the right of cover and beats Rohit. Was a full ball outside off. Slightly uppish but gets it in the gap and got it off at a good pace
Hurried up on the pull again, this one's on a shortish length outside off at 137kph and goes under the bat
Bouncer zips just over the batter's head after beating the pull. Given wide and Archer isn't happy about it
Slower full toss slips out wide, it's around sixth stump and is patted with limited timing to cover
Bunts a pull in the pocket at midwicket, man in the deep runs to the right and then in front but is unable to stop two. Bouncer was just outside off
Rahane misses the help-along-the-way flick, gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball goes in the gap towards square leg. Was a length ball at 144kph
Legcutter on a fullish length curves a bit, goes on top of middle. Blocked back to the bowler
Back of length outside off, underedges a cut into the grass, goes to deep third. Pace: 140kph
Slightly short around fifth, pulled to the right of deep midwicket
Full on middle and off, the 81kph ball is swept off the bottom-half of the horizontal bat to deep square leg
Googly lands around off and turns away to around fifth stump, Conway guides it to short third
Full ball is defended to the leg side
Belts a length ball outside off to long-off

Piyush outfoxes Ruturaj's positive intent, finds the top edge off the pull and Kishan takes it after running to his right. That was an 85kph ball that was given air, landed on a length and spun away. Gaikwad looked to clear his front leg but that worked against him.

Beaten on the inside edge. Archer lands a rocket on a slightly back of length. It's in the mid-140kph range, zaps in and beats Conway's full-faced defence. The ball went over middle and off, Conway was hopping back and was rattled
Length around top of off, angles the bat and defends it to point
Short and wide, Conway chops it into the grass with power and the ball goes over the leaping point fielder, who tried to palm it with a swoosh
Length on top of middle and off, nudged in the gap at midwicket
Pushes the full ball outside off to cover
Conway whips it off the stumps, the ball flies over midwicket. Into the outfield, four. The ball was on a fullish length at middle and Conway timed the bones out of it
Ruturaj gets a shortish ball around the waist and swivels as he pulls it fine. Over long leg for a six to end a 20-run over.
Pitched up and Gaikwad waits, punches it past the bowler. Checks it a bit and holds the pose
Length around off, flicked to midwicket
Steered behind point, deep point runs to the left and puts in the dive. Can't reach it though. Arshad is frustrated. That was a length ball outside off that Gaikwad played within the crease
Pulled over midwicket, goes a few rows back for a 75-metre six. The 133kph ball pitched around a back of length, sat up well for Gaikwad to smash it in front of square
Length in the channel, defended to point off the back foot
Fullish ball on off, defended back to the bowler
Length ball is defended to mid-off
Whipped fine, it's in the gap. Conway went across and played that expansive flick with the flashy follow-through
Length on top of middle at 142kph, blocked back to the bowler
Pitched up on fifth stump, no swing but still finds the thick inside edge off the attempted off drive. Ball squeezes to deep-backward square
Length on leg at 140kph, nudged towards square leg for a quick single
Leg-stump half-volley is clipped with ease over midwicket
Crisply drives the full ball on middle to mid-off
Wide down leg. The full ball pitched outside leg and angled away further, past the attempted flick
Length in the channel, defended late with an angled bat. Bounces on the pitch behind the stumps, onto the keeper
Pitched up and Gaikwad lofts it over the bowler. Not perfectly timed, Jofra chases from mid-on, runs close to the boundary and decides not to dive as it pops over
Punches a length ball on fourth stump at 140kph to mid-on. Siren goes off. That's a front-foot no-ball. Green's foot was on the crease upon first stride
Length outside off, driven to cover
Wide on a length, cut to cover with limited timing
